blockers: B1 - No RGS integration in any configuration. createRgsClient() has zero call sites; the production bundle contains zero occurrences of wallet/play, wallet/authenticate, wallet/end-round, rgs_url or sessionID (cd dist && grep -ho 'wallet/[a-z-]*' assets/*.js returns nothing). The slot resolves outcomes client-side in src/game/slots/resolveSpin.ts and pays from src/SlotApp.svelte:114 startingBalance = 1000 * MONEY_SCALE. Stage 6; checklist items 20-37 and 73-77 are unreachable, not merely failing.

B2 - A mock wallet ships in the production bundle. 'demo wallet: insufficient balance', 'demo wallet: a round is already open' and the demo-flight round-id prefix are all present in dist/assets/*.js (src/stake/flightRound.ts:264, wired at src/SlotApp.svelte:1470). Checklist item 88; trap T17; the Slot O' Verse COMPLIANCE.md failure repeated.

B3 - A force/cheat panel is reachable by any player in the production build. Load ?force-event, click PLAY, pick the Vegan Spins door, click the FORCE tab: buttons force 3/4/5 scatters, five-of-a-kinds, the expanding-wild duel, the shot and a board of wilds. Forced 5x Aubergine moved the balance 1,000.00 -> 1,047.00 on a $1.00 stake. Gate at src/ui/ForcePanel.svelte:47-55. Checklist item 88.

B4 - The game is completely silent. Zero audio files in the repository or dist (find ... -iname '*.mp3' etc -> 0) and zero playback APIs (no AudioContext, new Audio(, createBufferSource, decodeAudioData, <audio). src/game/sound.svelte.ts:6-8 states 'nothing here plays anything'. A full mixer UI ships and the Settings tab tells the player 'This game has no audio yet'. Stage 1; checklist item 55; DEFECT-CORPUS P1, the axis that scored a real reviewer's 1.33 for merely placeholder cues.

B5 - The disclaimer is one sentence of the seven required points: src/ui/MenuModal.svelte:1162 'Malfunction voids all pays and plays.' Missing internet requirement, disconnection recovery, expected return over many plays, display accuracy, payout source and copyright. approval-disclaimer.svx: games without a disclaimer will not pass approval. The adjacent FAIR PLAY copy asserts the opposite of the required payout-source point.
findings: F1 - Social/sweepstakes mode entirely unwired. src/game/social.svelte.ts holds a complete 20-entry swap table with the morphology trap solved, but setSocial() and socialLabel() have no call sites; the module was tree-shaken out (cd dist && grep -ho 'setSocial' assets/*.js | wc -l -> 0). PAYTABLE, PAYOUTS, PAYING, payout, BUY panel, BUY button, BUYING A ROUND and BET render in the clear. Neither ?social=true nor config.jurisdiction.socialCasino is read. Items 2-12; traps T1, T2; defects C3, C7.

F2 - Currency: one Intl.NumberFormat with no fraction digits and no roundingMode (src/game/money.svelte.ts:82-88) serves balance, bet and win alike. KWD renders Balance/Bet at 3dp (KWD 1,000.000), JPY at 0dp, against the required exactly-2dp; and money rounds UP (147.705 -> $147.71). Items 16, 18; trap T4; defects C4, C8. Aggravated by setCurrency() never being called, so the game runs only in USD and items 17, 19 and 29 are untestable.

F3 - Four hit-rate/probability numbers in player copy: 'free spins arrive about 1 in 4 spins instead of 1 in 451' and 'free spins land 3x as often' (Rules tab); 'about 1 spin in 451' and 'once in 1,048,576 spins' (About tab). Item 57; trap T12's inverse rule.

F4 - No spacebar binding of any kind. Twenty Space presses on the idle board left the board, balance ($1,000.00) and win ($0.00) unchanged; no keydown handler exists on the bet action. Item 41; items 42-43 moot in consequence.
F5 - No UI guide. Menu tabs are Rules/Paytable/Settings/About; no button glossary anywhere in MenuModal.svelte. Six bar controls unexplained. Item 54.
F6 - Insufficient funds is a silent no-op. src/SlotApp.svelte:695 returns without a message; no insufficient-funds string exists in the UI outside autoplay's stop reason at :2020. Item 24.

F7 - Max win disagrees three ways in one build. config.ts:125 wincapMult 50,000 renders as a single game-wide pill on the first screen (IntroScreen.svelte:834) directly above the Felix card; BuyPanel.svelte:93 and config.ts:117 say Felix tops out at 9,257x; the published pack has every Felix mode reaching exactly 50,000x. Item 48; trap T11; defect C6. The Rules tab's per-mode PRICE/RTP/MAX WIN table is correct in shape.

F8 - Advertised max win not reachable at 1-in-20,000,000: base 1-in-25,000,048 and felixBase 1-in-25,000,344, computed from the published weights. Designed in at src/game/wincap.ts:85 CAP_PER_STAKE = 1/25,000,000. approval-checklist.json item 51; checklist item 97.

F9 - Payout gap below the maximum in all three Felix modes: felixBase jumps 445.92x -> 50,000x (112x with nothing between), felixEnhanced 25.6x, felixSuperEnhanced 25.4x; base 11.7x. The four slot buy/enhancer modes are smooth. Item 99.

F10 - No internationalisation at all: no locale catalogs, no translate(), no ?lang read in the app. ?lang=zzinvalid loads cleanly with zero console errors (item 38 passes by not reading the parameter) but item 39 fails outright and item 40 has no mechanism.

F11 - No session, so no resume. Mid-spin reload raises no browser dialog (item 34 genuinely passes, zero beforeunload) but returns to the intro with balance reset to $1,000.00, bet reset to default and the in-flight round lost. Items 30-33, 35.
F12 - 23.84 MB across 502 unique files loaded before the game is playable, measured from the server log across a full boot. Item 61.
F13 - MEGA and EPIC win presentations run 20s and 26s in silence (src/game/winBanner.ts:67-68). Skippable. DEFECT-CORPUS P4.
F14 - Cosmetic: the intro's centre card overlaps its own '& SUPER FREE' subtitle behind the icon plate; at 390x844 the control-bar canvas is 402px wide at x=-6 in a 390px viewport.
